name: io.github.stackin-io/stackin
title: Stackin
description: Issue and manage Brazilian fiscal documents: NF-e for goods, NFS-e for services.

tools.name: issue_invoice
tools.description:
Issue a Brazilian fiscal document: NFS-e or NF-e.

This produces a legal fiscal document. Confirm the data with the
user before calling when you inferred any field.

Send unit_price with quantity when the user quotes a price per
unit, amount when they quote the line; both must agree.

nfse is a service invoice, one line per document (more is 422
NFSE_SINGLE_ITEM): the address is optional and service_code (LC
116/2003 item.subitem) falls back to the company's fiscal
profile. The nfse group fills the DPS (competence, ISS, federal
taxes, deductions, substitution and the rest) with only what the
user gave, never a guess. nbs is confirmed with the user:
suggest_nbs lists the candidates. An MEI cannot send what the
nfse group's description lists as refused for it. nfe is for goods, and the SEFAZ rejects
a partial one: ncm and cfop on every item and the full
recipient_address. Call validate_invoice_payload first when any of
that was inferred.

A complementary, adjustment or return NF-e sets purpose and names
the original in referenced_keys; a return the company receives
back sets direction in. An export has recipient_address state EX
with country_code, the export group, and foreign_id for a passport.

Look the recipient up with list_clients and pass its id as
client_id. A new recipient is saved as a client after issuance.

Pass idempotency_key, one per business event, when a retry is
possible: the same key and payload replays the first answer.
Without one, a retry after a lost response issues again, burning
another credit and number that only a cancellation within its
deadline undoes. Nothing generates the key for you.

Tell the user each of the result's warnings
(MEI_ACTIVITY_NOT_ALLOWED, ACTIVITY_NOT_REGISTERED,
MEI_NO_ICMS_ACTIVITY, APPROXIMATE_TAXES_MISSING, IBS_CBS_RECOMMENDED
and the other *_RECOMMENDED). block_activity_mismatch makes the first two
a 422, nothing sent.

Before a company's first document, get_company_readiness says
whether it can issue at all.

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

items.description: One entry per line. Each needs a description and a price: unit_price with quantity, or amount for the whole line, or an item_id from list_items for these and the fiscal codes; what the line sends wins. nfe also needs ncm (8 digits) and cfop (4 digits) on every item; nfse takes one line only. Groups in full: the stackin://schemas/invoice-item resource.

description.description: Required unless item_id names a catalog item.

item_id.description: A catalog item from list_items: fills what the line leaves out.

barcode.description: cEAN: a GTIN-8/12/13/14, or SEM GTIN.

ncm.description: The full 8 digits, or 00 for a service line. Any other short code the SEFAZ rejects with 777.

items.description: A presumed tax credit applied to this item.

recopi_number.description: nRECOPI: 20 digits, the last two modulo-11 check digits.

ibs_cbs.description: IBS/CBS: cst (3 digits), classification (cClassTrib, 6). nfe: rate_state, rate_city, rate_federal; base, reduction_ibs, reduction_cbs when they apply. nfse: operation_indicator (cIndOp, 6 digits), personal_use, government, referenced_nfse, recipient, real_estate, movable_goods, regular_taxation, deferral, presumed_credit. Full shape in the stackin://schemas/invoice-item resource.

tax.description: The item's taxes, already computed: icms, icms_uf_dest, ipi, pis, pis_st, cofins, cofins_st and v_tot_trib, each ICMS variant chosen by its cst or csosn. Leave it out unless the user gave the computed values. Full shape in the stackin://schemas/invoice-item resource.

fuel.description: The NF-e fuel group (comb), needed for a fuel CFOP: anp_code (9 digits), anp_description and consumer_state, plus optional GLP percentages. Full shape in the stackin://schemas/invoice-item resource.

nbs.description: NBS code of the service, nfse only.

municipal_service_code.description: cTribMun, the municipality's own code, three digits. nfse only.

internal_code.description: cIntContrib, the issuer's own code for the service. nfse only.

conditional_discount.description: Conditional discount in BRL, nfse only.

tax_retained.description: ISSQN retained by the tomador, nfse only.

client_name.description: Recipient's name. Required unless client_id is sent.

tax_id.description: Recipient's CPF or CNPJ. Required unless client_id is sent.

client_id.description: A saved client's id, from list_clients: it fills what this call leaves out. Without it, client_name and tax_id are required.

update_client.description: Save the recipient data sent here onto client_id's client.

client_email.description: Optional. Recipient e-mail, written into the document when valid. Omitted: client_id's.

client_phone.description: Optional. Recipient phone, written into the document when valid. Omitted: client_id's.

recipient_address.description: Required for nfe, with street, number, neighborhood, city, state (UF), zip_code (8 digits) and city_code (7-digit IBGE, e.g. 3550308); optional for nfse. Abroad: state EX and country_code (nfse: country_iso2). With client_id, omit it to use the saved one.

country_code.description: BACEN code, 1 to 4 digits. Required, not 1058, when state is EX.

country_iso2.description: ISO alpha-2 of a buyer abroad, nfse only.

province.description: State, province or region abroad, NFS-e only.

state_registration.description: IE, NF-e only: the number for an ICMS contributor, ISENTO if exempt, left out for a non-contributor.

series.description: Document series (série), e.g. 1. Omitted means the company's default series.

number.description: Document number, e.g. 1532. Omitted means the company's next; set it only to fill a known gap.

purpose.description: Why the NF-e is issued (finNFe): normal, complementary, adjustment or return of goods. nfe only; omitted means normal.

direction.description: out for an outgoing NF-e (CFOP 5/6/7); in for goods coming in, such as a sale returned (CFOP 1/2/3). nfe only; omitted means out.

referenced_keys.description: Access keys of the NF-e being returned, complemented or adjusted. Required for complementary (exactly one) and most returns. nfe only.

foreign_id.description: Passport or other document of a buyer abroad (state EX). An nfse needs it or foreign_id_missing_reason; an nfe may omit it.

foreign_id_missing_reason.description: nfse only, a buyer abroad with no foreign_id: 1 exempt, 2 the country has no tax number.

recipient_municipal_registration.description: nfse only: the recipient's inscricao municipal. Omitted with client_id: the saved client's.

nfse.description: nfse only, all optional: competence_date, service_city_code, service_country_code, approximate_taxes, iss, federal, deductions, substitution, construction, event, references, provider (caepf, phone, email), recipient_caepf, intermediary, foreign_trade. An MEI cannot send federal, deductions, iss.rate, iss.municipal_benefit, approximate_taxes.simples_percent or an item's municipal_service_code: 422 *_NOT_FOR_MEI. Full shape in the stackin://schemas/nfse resource.

export.description: Where the goods leave Brazil (exporta): exit_state (UF), place (e.g. Porto de Santos), optional dispatch_place (customs). Required for an nfe to a buyer abroad (state EX), refused otherwise.

external_reference.description: The caller's own id for this document, such as an order number. Stored as sent and returned on every read.

discount.description: Discount on the whole document, BRL, e.g. 15.50, spread over the lines pro rata. Omitted means none; a per-line one goes on the item.

issued_at.description: Emission date-time (dhEmi), ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-11-15T09:30:00-03:00; one without an offset is refused. Omitted means now. nfe: up to 30 days back, 5 minutes ahead; nfse: never future. Set it only when the user asks.

contingency.description: nfe only: use the contingency authorizer (SVC-AN or SVC-RS) because the state's is down. Only when the user says so, never as a retry for a rejection.

presence.description: nfe, optional. Buyer presence (indPres): 1 in person, 2 internet, 3 phone, 5 off-site, 9 other, 0 n/a. Ask the user.

intermediary.description: nfe, optional. Marketplace the sale went through: tax_id (CNPJ) and identifier (the seller's id there).

transport.description: nfe, optional. freight_mode (modFrete): 0 sender, 1 recipient, 2 third party, 3 sender's own, 4 recipient's own, 9 none; ask the user, never infer. volumes: [{quantity, species, brand, numbering, net_weight, gross_weight in kg}].

payments.description: nfe, optional, up to 100: {method (tPag, e.g. 01 cash, 03 credit card, 17 Pix, 99 other with description), amount, description, card {integration, tax_id, brand, authorization}}. Ask the user, never infer.

change.description: nfe, optional. Change given back (vTroco), BRL.

idempotency_key.description: One per business event, e.g. order-1042. Printable ASCII up to 255, no leading or trailing space.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: consult_invoice
tools.description:
Look up an invoice's current status. Read-only.

After an OUTCOME_UNKNOWN issuance, consult its document_id: the
dps_id of an nfse, the access_key of an nfe. A 404 on a dps_id
means nothing was issued.

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

access_key.description: The access key (chave de acesso) the authorizer assigned, as issue_invoice and list_invoices return it. An NF-e key has 44 characters; the issuer's CNPJ inside it may carry letters since July 2026, so copy it exactly.

dps_id.description: nfse instead of access_key: its DPS id.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: cancel_invoice
tools.description:
Cancel an authorized invoice.

Legal cancellation, with fiscal and accounting effect, inside a window
the NFS-e authorizer enforces for the municipality. Ask the human to confirm before calling; never call it
speculatively. The reason reaches the tax authority verbatim and must
be at least 15 characters.

Pass idempotency_key to make a retry safe: repeating the same key with
the same access key and reason replays the first answer instead of
cancelling a second time. Reuse the key only when retrying that exact
call; a genuinely new cancellation needs a new key, or none. Nothing
generates one for you — two calls without a key are two cancellations.

access_key.description: The access key (chave de acesso) the authorizer assigned, as issue_invoice and list_invoices return it. An NF-e key has 44 characters; the issuer's CNPJ inside it may carry letters since July 2026, so copy it exactly.

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

reason.description: Why the document is cancelled, 15 to 256 characters. It reaches the tax authority verbatim, e.g. Erro no valor do servico prestado.

idempotency_key.description: One per business event, e.g. order-1042. Printable ASCII up to 255, no leading or trailing space.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: get_invoice_pdf
tools.description:
Return the printable rendering of a document, as a PDF.

Works for both types — a DANFE for nfe, a DANFSe for nfse. The PDF
comes back base64-encoded in content_base64, with its size in
size_bytes; the XML, not this, is the legally valid document. A
PDF above 2 MB is not inlined: the answer says to download it from
the API instead. A 502 from here means the authorizer is
unavailable, not that the invoice is wrong.

access_key.description: The access key (chave de acesso) the authorizer assigned, as issue_invoice and list_invoices return it. An NF-e key has 44 characters; the issuer's CNPJ inside it may carry letters since July 2026, so copy it exactly.

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: reissue_invoice
tools.description:
Retry a rejected invoice after the data that caused the rejection
was fixed.

Takes the local invoice_id, not the access key: a rejected document
never got one. Consumes a credit like a new issuance, so it takes
an idempotency_key for the same reason issue_invoice does. An
authorized invoice is corrected or cancelled, never reissued.

invoice_id.description: The local invoice id (a UUID), as list_invoices and issue_invoice return it. Not the access key.

idempotency_key.description: One per business event, e.g. order-1042. Printable ASCII up to 255, no leading or trailing space.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: correct_invoice
tools.description:
File an electronic correction letter (CC-e) against an NF-e.

NF-e only: there is no correction letter for an NFS-e, where a wrong
document is cancelled and issued again.

It corrects wording and non-fiscal fields only. It cannot change
values, taxes, the recipient or the products — those still require
cancelling and issuing again, and telling the user a CC-e will fix
an amount is wrong in a way they only discover at an audit.

Each letter supersedes the previous one and the SEFAZ keeps at most
20 per document. The text reaches the tax authority verbatim.

access_key.description: The access key (chave de acesso) the authorizer assigned, as issue_invoice and list_invoices return it. An NF-e key has 44 characters; the issuer's CNPJ inside it may carry letters since July 2026, so copy it exactly.

correction.description: The corrected wording, 15 to 1000 characters, sent verbatim, e.g. Onde se le Rua A, leia-se Rua B. Replaces any earlier letter, so repeat what still applies.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: invalidate_numbering
tools.description:
Declare an NF-e numbering range reserved but never used.

NF-e numbering has to be continuous, so a gap left by a failed
issuance is explained to the SEFAZ with this — not with a new
document. Irreversible: a number declared unused can never be used.

Only for numbers that were never authorized. An authorized document
is cancelled, never invalidated. Confirm the range with the user and
read it back before calling: the range is inclusive, and one digit
wrong burns numbers the company still needs.

The SDK refuses a backwards range and a reason outside 15-255
characters before anything is transmitted.

series.description: The NF-e series of the range, e.g. 1.

number_end.description: Last unused number, inclusive; equal to number_start for a single number.

reason.description: Why the numbers went unused, 15 to 255 characters, sent verbatim, e.g. Falha no sistema durante a emissao.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description:
List the invoices this company issued, newest first.

One document type at a time: pass nfse for services or nfe for
goods. A company that issues both has to be asked twice.

Use it for "my last invoices", "what was rejected today", and to find
a document whose access key the user does not have at hand. Read-only.

An authorized document is stored as issued, which is the value the
rows carry; authorized is accepted as a synonym and asks for the
same thing.

Every row carries both identifiers the other tools need: id, which
reissue_invoice takes, and access_key, which consult_invoice,
cancel_invoice and get_invoice_pdf take. A rejected
row has an id and no access key — the authorizer never assigned one.

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

status.description: Only rows in this state. authorized is a synonym for issued. All states when omitted.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

include_items.description: Keep each row's item lines and fiscal_operation. Off by default: they are most of the size, and a page of 100 NF-e with them is about 130 KB. consult_invoice brings one document's lines back.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: get_invoice_submissions
tools.description:
Show every attempt made for one invoice and what came back.

This is the tool that answers "why was it rejected". consult_invoice
gives the status; this gives the tax authority's own code, its
message, and the request and response exactly as they went over the
wire. Read-only.

It takes the invoice_id, like reissue_invoice — a rejected document
has no access key to look it up by. Get the id from list_invoices.

The rows are attempts, not documents: a reissued invoice has more
than one, oldest first, and only the last describes the current
state. Quote the authority's message rather than paraphrasing it;
the code is what the user will search for.

invoice_id.description: The local invoice id (a UUID), as list_invoices and issue_invoice return it. Not the access key.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: invoice_stats
tools.description:
Count this company's documents, and compare recent days.

The answer to "how many invoices this month", "how much did I
bill" and "is rejection going up": totals by document type and
by status over everything, then issued and rejected counts and
the amount for the last `days` beside the `days` before them,
and one row per day. In the connection's environment only.
Read-only.

days.description: The window compared with the one before it, in days. 30 by default.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: list_invalidations
tools.description:
List the NF-e numbering ranges this company already declared
unused, newest first.

Read it before invalidate_numbering: a range reported twice is
refused, and one that overlaps a past report means the gap was
already explained. Each row has the series, the inclusive range,
the reason, the SEFAZ status and its protocol. Read-only.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: validate_invoice_payload
tools.description:
Dry-run issue_invoice: the API runs issuance's pre-authority
checks (company blockers; NCM, CEST, IBS/CBS and presumed-credit
tables; layout and cross-field rules). Nothing is sent, numbered,
stored or charged. Malformed fields come back first, without the
API.

It does not replace issuing: the authorizer can still reject what
passes (recipient registration, a number already used).

document_type.description: nfse for a service invoice, nfe for goods.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: list_received_invoices
tools.description:
List NF-e documents other companies issued against this one.

The mirror of list_invoices: that one shows what this company issued,
this one what it received. Read-only.

It reads what the API already collected and never calls the tax
authority; collection runs every six hours and
sync_received_invoices asks now. Each row carries the issuer, the
amount, has_full_document and, once one was filed, the
manifestation; final_answer_due means only an awareness was filed.
Before a manifestation the authority sends a summary only; the full
document arrives after one.

Past the plan's monthly allowance each new one costs credit
(get_usage).

The result carries sync, how fresh the list is. When sync.status is
cooling_down or failing, tell the user the list may be incomplete
and when the next read is possible (sync.next_sync_at). When
sync.competing_reader is true, give sync.hint: another system (an
ERP, the accountant) reads the same CNPJ with the same certificate
and only the customer can stop it. Do not call
sync_received_invoices before sync.next_sync_at: asking early
renews the block.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: sync_received_invoices
tools.description:
Ask the tax authority now for NF-e issued against this company.

Collection already runs every six hours. After a read that finds
nothing more the authority imposes a one-hour wait; inside it this
is refused with the time to retry (next_sync_at, the same instant
list_received_invoices reports in sync). Never retry in a loop, and
never ask before that instant: asking early renews the block.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: manifest_received_invoice
tools.description:
Declare this company's position on a document issued against it.

Legally binding and irreversible once the tax authority accepts it —
ask the human to confirm before calling, and read back which
document and which of the four positions is being filed.

Denying a document (210220) or declaring the operation did not
happen (210240) is an accusation against whoever issued it. Never
pick either because the user sounds unsure — ask.

210200 confirms the operation happened, 210210 acknowledges the
document exists, 210220 denies knowing it, and 210240 states the
operation was not carried out. Only 210240 takes a reason, and it
requires one; the others are refused if a reason is sent.

access_key.description: The 44-character access key of the received NF-e, as list_received_invoices returns it.

manifestation.description: 210200 confirms the operation, 210210 acknowledges the document, 210220 denies knowing it, 210240 states the operation was not carried out.

reason.description: Required with 210240 and refused with any other code, e.g. Mercadoria nao foi entregue.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: get_received_invoice_xml
tools.description:
Return the full XML (procNFe) of an NF-e issued against this
company. Read-only and never charged.

Only when list_received_invoices shows has_full_document; for a
summary the answer says to manifest first. An XML above 500 KB is
not inlined: the answer says to download it from the API instead.

access_key.description: The 44-character access key of the received NF-e, as list_received_invoices returns it.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: lookup_fiscal_code
tools.description:
Resolve one code of one classification, when you know both.

Use this to confirm a code before putting it on a document —
an NCM that does not exist is rejected by the tax authority
after issuing, which costs a cancellation.

A code that is not there answers 404. That means the code is
wrong, not that the lookup failed; do not retry it.

`metadata` differs per kind and is passed through as published:
utrib on an NCM, ncm_code on a CEST, tax_type on a CST, and
nothing at all on an ISS service.

code.description: The code itself, as published: 84716052 for an NCM, 5102 for a CFOP. Digits only, no dots.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. A code means nothing without it, and Brazil is the default rather than a guess.

tools.name: search_fiscal_codes
tools.description:
Find a code from a description, or page through a table.

This is the tool for "what NCM is a keyboard" — the one the
user actually asks. Prefer it over guessing a code from memory:
the tables change, and a plausible wrong code is worse than a
lookup.

Leaving `kind` unset searches every classification of that
country at once, which is the most expensive call here. Set it
whenever the question already names one.

Rows come back ordered by kind then code; there is no sort
argument, and asking for one changes nothing.

kind.description: Narrows to one classification. All if unset.

term.description: Matches the code or the description.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use it to page, not to narrow — a term is cheaper than paging to find one row.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. A code means nothing without it, and Brazil is the default rather than a guess.

tools.name: list_fiscal_kinds
tools.description:
Which classifications this country has data for, right now.

Ask this before assuming a classification exists. The answer
grows as the source data does, so a name absent here is absent
today rather than absent forever.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. A code means nothing without it, and Brazil is the default rather than a guess.

tools.name: lookup_taxpayer
tools.description:
Look up one taxpayer by exact tax id, to confirm who it is.

Use it to check a recipient's name before issuing against them.
It takes the id exactly — punctuation is fine, but there is no
search by name, by prefix or by state, and there will not be:
the registry holds the names and addresses of real people.

A 404 does not mean the company does not exist. The registry
reloads monthly from the RFB's dump, so a recently registered
CNPJ is simply not in it yet. Say that to the user rather than
reporting the tax id as invalid, and never turn a 404 here into
a validation rule.

tax_id.description: The exact tax id. A CNPJ is 14 characters and may carry letters in its first 12 since July 2026 (e.g. 12ABC34501DE35); a CPF is 11 digits. Punctuation is fine.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. A code means nothing without it, and Brazil is the default rather than a guess.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description:
Find a municipality's IBGE code from its name.

Issuing resolves city_code from city and state by itself, so this
is for the name that matches more than one city, or an address
the API answered CITY_NOT_FOUND for. Returns at most 20, each
with its code, name and state; ask the user which one when more
than one fits. Read-only.

name.description: The start of the city's name, accents optional, e.g. santa rita.

state.description: Narrows to one UF, e.g. SP.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. A code means nothing without it, and Brazil is the default rather than a guess.

tools.name: calculate_ibs_cbs
tools.description:
Simulate IBS/CBS per item and in total. Issues nothing.

Not a fiscal document: say so to the user. Rates left out use
the official 2026 ones in 2026; outside 2026 they are required.

amount.description: Item amount; base if no base.

document_type.description: Model the cClassTrib is checked for; amounts are the NF-e's.

tools.name: suggest_nbs
tools.description:
List the NBS codes NFS-e Anexo VIII pairs with a service code.

Suggestions, not a decision: show them to the user and put an nbs
on the item only after they pick one. Each carries the cIndOp and
cClassTrib Anexo VIII lists for it, which belong in the item's
ibs_cbs group only when the user also confirms them. Empty when
the annex lists none.

service_code.description: The LC 116 item.subitem as items[].service_code takes it: 1.07, 01.07.00 or 010700.

tools.name: list_authorized_companies
tools.description:
List the companies this connection may act for, and what it may
do on each.

Call it before acting when the user has more than one company, or
when a tool answered that it needs a company. Each row carries the
company_id (UUID) and tax_id (CNPJ or CPF) the other tools accept as
company_id or company_tax_id, and the permissions granted there.

One connection may cover several companies; when it covers only
one, the other tools need no company at all. Read-only.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description:
The plan's allowances, what is used and the credit left.

Read it before saying an action is free. Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: get_company_readiness
tools.description:
Whether the company can issue right now, and if not, what to fix.

Call it before a company's first document, and when issuing
fails for a reason that is not the document's. ready is false
with missing naming the cause; by_document_type has it per nfe
and nfse, each blocker with the fields at fault and each warning
a default being declared; fix_url is the dashboard screen for
the first blocker.

What to do with it:
- address: offer to fill it in here. Read the company's own
  registry row with lookup_taxpayer, show the user the address,
  and call update_company once they confirm.
- state_registration: ask the user for the IE, then
  update_company.
- certificate, certificate_expired, certificate_unreadable, plan:
  only the dashboard fixes them; give the user fix_url.
- update_company refused for lack of company:write: give fix_url
  and tell the user to reconnect Stackin to allow company
  settings.

Do not call it again until something changed — an update_company,
or the user saying they fixed it: the answer will be the same.
Also the certificate's expiry, the tax regime (CRT), the state,
the default série per document type and what the registry
suggests for the fiscal fields. Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: update_company
tools.description:
Fill in or fix the company's own address and fiscal fields —
what get_company_readiness reports missing.

Before calling it: read the company's own registry row with
lookup_taxpayer (its CNPJ), show the user the address you are
about to write, and call only after they confirm it. Never
invent or guess a field; leave out what neither the registry nor
the user gave. The state cannot change here.

The registry row keeps street_type, street, number and
neighborhood under metadata.address and the CEP as postal_code.
Its city_code is the Receita's code (4 digits), not IBGE, and it
has no city name: get the name with
lookup_fiscal_code(kind="city", code=<city_code>) and send it as
municipality_name, or send search_cities' 7-digit code as
municipality_code.

The fiscal fields (tax_regime, simples_nacional, simples_apuracao,
simples_apuracao_ibs_cbs, state_registration, service_code,
municipal_registration, special_tax_regime, iss_rate and the
approximate_tax_*_percent ones) decide what every future document
declares and owes: send them only when the user states them,
never from a registry suggestion alone. They are the company
owner's alone. An empty string clears municipal_registration,
iss_rate and the approximate_tax_*_percent ones.

Only what is sent changes. Answers with the readiness fields
plus the address and fiscal fields as stored: when ready is
true the company can issue, with no need to ask
get_company_readiness again. Needs company:write.

number.description: Street number, or SN when there is none.

municipality_code.description: The 7-digit IBGE code of a city in the company's state (search_cities finds it). Never the registry's 4-digit city_code, padded or not. Leave it out to send municipality_name.

municipality_name.description: The city's name; the IBGE code is found from it in the company's state. Send it or municipality_code; both must agree.

zip_code.description: CEP, 8 digits; the mask is fine.

tax_regime.description: CRT: 1 Simples, 2 Simples excesso, 3 normal, 4 MEI.

simples_nacional.description: NFS-e Simples Nacional option (opSimpNac): 1 no, 2 MEI, 3 ME/EPP.

state_registration.description: State registration (IE), digits or ISENTO; an NF-e needs it.

simples_apuracao.description: NFS-e regApTribSN of an ME/EPP: 1, 2 or 3.

simples_apuracao_ibs_cbs.description: How an ME/EPP pays IBS/CBS: 1 in the DAS, 3 outside it; only 3 lets its NFS-e carry the IBS/CBS group in production.

municipal_registration.description: Inscricao municipal (provider IM), up to 15 letters or digits.

special_tax_regime.description: NFS-e regEspTrib: 0 none, 1 cooperative, 2 estimativa, 3 municipal microempresa, 4 notario/registrador, 5 autonomo, 6 sociedade de profissionais, 9 other. An MEI, and an ME/EPP with simples_apuracao 1, take only 0.

iss_rate.description: ISSQN rate in percent, above 0 and at most 5.

approximate_tax_simples_percent.description: ME/EPP Simples approximate tax percentage (Lei 12.741), 0 to 99.99.

tools.name: explain_rejection
tools.description:
Explain why a rejected document was refused and what to change.

get_invoice_submissions has the authority's reply as sent; this
reads it for someone who does not speak SEFAZ: the code, the
message verbatim, what it means, the steps to fix it, the field
at fault and, when there is one, a suggested value. Quote the
code and the message to the user; they are what they will search
for. A suggested value is confirmed with the user before
reissue_invoice, never applied on its own.

transient means the authority was unavailable, not the data
wrong. A document that is not rejected is refused (409).
Read-only.

invoice_id.description: The local id of the rejected invoice, as list_invoices returns it. A rejected document has no access key.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.

tools.name: classify_item
tools.description:
Suggest an NCM, CFOP, CST/CSOSN, CEST or service code for one
item. A suggestion to confirm with the user — never issue on it
blindly.

Every code in a candidate was read from the published tables, but
the NCM and the CFOP decide the tax owed, and a plausible wrong
one is authorized by the SEFAZ and only caught at an audit. Show
the primary candidate, its confidence and the alternatives, say
it is a suggestion, and put a code on an item only after the user
confirms it — whatever the confidence. lookup_fiscal_code can
confirm one code against the table.

When missing_information is not empty, ask the user those
questions and call again with the answers in the matching
arguments. Changes nothing.

description.description: What the item is, as the user describes it, e.g. Cerveja artesanal IPA garrafa 500ml.

document_type.description: nfe for goods, nfse for a service.

recipient_state.description: The buyer's UF, e.g. SP. It decides intrastate (5xxx) or interstate (6xxx) CFOP.

operation_scope.description: Only when missing_information asked for it.

purpose.description: Whether the buyer resells it or consumes it. Only when missing_information asked for it.

contains_alcohol.description: Only when missing_information asked for it.

service_city_code.description: IBGE code of the city where the service is provided. Only when missing_information asked for it.

tax_retained.description: Whether the ISS is retained by the buyer. Only when missing_information asked for it.

Needs webhook:manage. Read-only.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description:
Register a URL to receive this company's document events.

Every document authorized, rejected, cancelled or corrected, and
every received NF-e first stored (received_invoice.stored) or
whose full XML arrived (received_invoice.full_document), is then
sent there, signed with the secret. Confirm the URL with the user
before calling: it is where their fiscal data goes. The API refuses a URL that is not HTTPS or points at a
private network. Needs webhook:manage.

Calling it twice registers two endpoints, and each receives every
event: list_webhooks first.

url.description: Where to deliver, an https:// URL the user gave. Never one you made up.

secret.description: 16 to 255 characters the user chose; every delivery is signed with it. It is never shown again, so do not repeat it back.

events.description: Which events to send. Every one if omitted.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit for a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. Send one, never both.
